description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two sofas in upper right living zone arranged in an L, facing toward the centre of the room and exterior windows. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower and toilet). Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobes shown); people who work from home (no desk space in any bedroom); anyone requiring a bathtub (only showers present).
